newsitem.title: USA: Vencor bid for Transitional Hospitals - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Vencor bid for Transitional Hospitals - WSJ.

text.p: Vencor Inc. offered to buy Transitional Hospitals Corp. for $639 million or $16 a share, days after Transitional agreed to be bought by Select Medical Corp. for $14.55 per share or $564.5 million, the Wall Street Journal said in Wednesday's electronic edition.
The company made its offer known in an advertisement in Wednesday's Journal, the newspaper said.

Vencor Chairman W. Bruce Lunsford was quoted in the paper as saying: "Transitional has clearly put itself up for sale and we're offering a cash price that is superior to the merger to which they have agreed."
Transitional said Sunday after it received a $14.55 per share cash offer from Select, it received a $15 per share cash offer from anther unnamed major healthcare provider.

The Journal quoted Transitional Chairman Richard Conte as saying he had not, as of Tuesday night, seen the new offer. But he was quoted by the paper as saying: "This offer will of course receive very serious consideration by our board of directors and the companys's advisers."
